_about: Built by tools/build-bangladesh-districts.mjs; do not edit. Bangladesh's 64 districts: boundaries from COD-AB v03 (bgd_admin2.geojson), each arc simplified once (Douglas–Peucker 0.002°) and stored once; Bengali names as the Bangladesh basemap has them (bangladesh.gov.bd, tools/sources/bangladesh-names.json), since COD-AB has none. An arc is [x0, y0, dx1, dy1, …] in units of 0.0001° (x longitude, y latitude); a district's ring lists arc indices, ~i meaning arc i reversed. An arc used by two districts is a boundary between them; one used once is Bangladesh's outline.
